definition.title: Draft a turnkey framework starter repository
definition.description: Reads your Code map and Feature map, selects a relevant developer framework ecosystem (Next.js, FastAPI, Vite/React, Express), and drafts a complete, runnable starter repository specification with minimal glue code, environment setup, and submission copy for framework template galleries. Research and drafting only; never publishes or creates repositories.

target_framework.title: Target framework (optional)
target_framework.description: Specific framework to target (e.g. nextjs, fastapi, vite-react, express). Leave empty to let the run select the highest-affinity ecosystem from the Code map.

use_case.title: Demonstrated use case (optional)
use_case.description: The specific developer problem to solve in the starter. Leave empty to draw the clearest core capability from the Feature map.

starter_name.title: Starter repository name (optional)
starter_name.description: Override for the repository slug (e.g. myproduct-nextjs-starter).

prerequisites.reason: The Code map identifies public APIs, SDKs, client libraries, authentication flows, and language ecosystems supported by the product.
The Feature map identifies the core user-facing capabilities that the starter demonstrates.
The onboarding plan names the primary developer persona, ICP, and hard no's.
A captured writing style guide shapes the starter README, quickstart instructions, and gallery listing description.
